w10_T4_003538: Amal's bookshop received 129 copies of a new novel, and a dozen customers had already reserved theirs. A second delivery brought 52 more copies, and 3 review copies were added to the shelf. During launch week, when the shop stayed open 9 hours a day, 164 copies were sold. Amal then sold each remaining copy to a library for 7 dollars, and the library also paid 48 dollars for delivery. How many dollars did the library pay in total?
w10_T4_003543: A bakery made 230 cupcakes and divided them equally among 5 charity stalls. The park stall also received 67 muffins to sell alongside its cupcakes. Every cupcake and muffin at the park stall sold for 9 cents. The stall also collected 60 cents in tips in the morning and 48 cents in tips in the afternoon. The volunteers wrote the total down in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents did the park stall collect altogether?
w10_T4_003547: In the morning, each of the 8 tankers at a dairy collected 226 litres of milk from the farms, and each tanker then took on 5 more litres at the gate. In the afternoon, a small farm delivered another 51 litres to the dairy's storage tank, and 919 litres were sold to a supermarket. In the evening, 549 litres were sent to the cheese room. The dairy's gauge shows kilolitres, but the manager keeps her records in litres, and a thousand litres make one kilolitre. How many litres of milk remain in the storage tank?
w10_T4_003551: In the morning, the housekeeper of a hotel counted the towels in the linen store: there were 8 cupboards with 82 towels in each. Before lunch 21 towels came back from the laundry and were added to the store. In the afternoon a delivery of 67 new towels arrived, and then 36 more came back from the laundry. In the evening 239 towels were taken from the store to the guest rooms. How many towels are in the linen store now?
w10_T4_003552: In the morning, Zara's savings jar held 141 dollars, and she added 53 dollars from her birthday and 55 dollars from selling old toys. In the afternoon her mother divided the jar's money equally among 3 jars, one for each of the children, and Zara kept only her own jar. Her grandmother then put 76 dollars into Zara's jar. In the evening her father promised to double whatever was in Zara's jar, and he did. How many dollars are in Zara's jar now?
w10_T4_003557: Rosa's orchard has 130 rows of trees with 9 trees in every row, while her neighbour Paco's orchard has only 100 rows. Half of Rosa's trees are pear trees. When Rosa retires she divides all her trees equally among her 5 children, and her daughter Ines receives one share. Ines then plants 27 more trees. Each of Ines's trees yields 6 kilograms of fruit in the first season, and she records the harvest in tonnes, since a thousand kilograms make one tonne. How many kilograms of fruit does Ines harvest?
w10_T4_003560: In the morning, Tobias set out with 140 flyers for the town fair, more than the 120 flyers his friend Klara was carrying. By midday he had handed out 61 flyers. In the afternoon he handed out 65 more, and 6 blew away in the wind. The town has 30 streets. In the evening he returned the flyers he still had to the printer, who paid him 4 cents for every flyer returned. How many cents did the printer pay Tobias?
w10_T4_003565: Grace's farm loads 189 sacks of potatoes onto each of 4 lorries, while Henry's farm manages only 150 sacks per lorry. A small van brings 50 more sacks from Grace's barn to join her load. Each sack weighs 5 kilograms. The pallets and wrapping add another 32 kilograms. The journey to the market takes 3 hours. How many kilograms does Grace's whole load weigh?
w10_T4_003574: Ivan's vineyard is planted with 102 vines in every row, 9 rows in every block, and 8 blocks in all, which is more vines than the 5000 on Olga's vineyard next door. A late frost kills 6772 of Ivan's vines. He replants 49 new vines in the spring. The harvest takes 12 days each autumn. How many vines does Ivan have now?
w10_T4_003576: In the morning, the community garden fund held 194 dollars. The treasurer split it equally between 2 accounts, and the seeds account received one of the equal parts. A sponsor then topped up the seeds account until it held 6 times as much as it had. In the afternoon, the seeds account was split equally between 2 bulk orders, and only the vegetable order was paid from it; then 72 dollars more went out of it for delivery. The garden has 40 members. In the evening, members paid 38 dollars and then 78 dollars in dues into the seeds account. How many dollars are in the seeds account now?
w10_T4_003580: A candle maker packed her stock into 46 cartons, and a dozen helpers carried them. Each carton holds 4 bags, and each bag holds 4 candles. She also had 23 candles on the counter and 13 candles in the window display. She then shared all the candles equally among 4 market stalls, one of which was the Bay stall. How many candles did the Bay stall receive?
w10_T4_003581: In the morning, Ben sold 6 cups of lemonade at 19 cents each, and it was 30 degrees outside. A customer gave him a 22 cent tip. He split all his money equally into 2 piles and gave 1 pile to his sister, who had helped. In the afternoon he earned 27 cents washing a neighbour's bicycle. In the evening his father gave him enough money to make his total 3 times as large. Ben writes his money in dollars in his notebook, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents does Ben have now?
w10_T4_003582: In the morning, each of the 7 stalls at the school fair took in 114 dollars, and the fair had 500 visitors. The organisers split the takings equally between 2 charities, and the hospice received one share. In the afternoon a raffle added 61 dollars to the hospice's share, and then the mayor matched the hospice's share dollar for dollar, doubling it. In the evening the hospice paid 234 dollars for a new wheelchair from that money. The hospice treasurer counts coins in cents but records the fund in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many dollars does the hospice have left from the fair?
w10_T4_003592: In the morning, 8 buses each brought 145 people to the riverside rally. Before lunch 856 people left. In the afternoon the crowd swelled to 6 times its size as marchers arrived, then 437 people went home and 79 more arrived. In the evening, when the concert started, the crowd grew to 3 times its size. How many people were at the rally during the concert?
w10_T4_003594: In the morning, each of 4 delivery vans brought 211 litres of orange juice to a festival tent. Before lunch a volunteer carried in 55 more litres. In the afternoon 123 litres were served to the crowd. In the evening a late van dropped off 13 litres more. The tent manager logs the juice in litres although the supplier bills in kilolitres, and a thousand litres make one kilolitre. How many litres of juice are in the tent now?
w10_T4_003595: In the morning, Aisha had collected 77 signatures for her petition, more than the 60 that Bilal had collected. Before lunch she collected 29 more. In the afternoon she gathered 35 signatures at the market and 54 outside the library. In the evening she collected 73 signatures at a concert and 13 at the bus station. How many signatures does Aisha have?
w10_T4_003604: In the morning, Chen made 207 portions of noodles and then made a second batch of exactly the same size, doubling his stock, while Wei's stall next door had 350 portions. By midday Chen had sold 113 portions. In the afternoon a helper brought 17 more portions. Chen packed 6 dumplings with every portion still on the stall. In the evening he divided all those dumplings equally into 6 boxes. How many dumplings are in the first box?
w10_T4_003605: In the morning, Dario's bike shop had 171 bicycles in stock, more than the 150 in Elsa's shop. By midday he had sold 101 bicycles, and 4 more were found to be damaged and removed. In the afternoon he fitted 8 reflectors to every remaining bicycle. He also had 9 spare reflectors in a drawer. In the evening a courier delivered 16 more reflectors. How many reflectors does Dario have in the shop?
w10_T4_003606: Fenna keeps a sourdough starter that weighs 87 grams, more than the 80 grams of starter her friend Gus keeps. She uses 85 grams of it in a loaf. She then feeds what is left with flour and water until it weighs 8 times as much. The next day she feeds it again until it weighs 8 times as much as before. Her oven bakes at 230 degrees. Finally she divides the starter into 2 equal portions and keeps only 1 portion in the jar. How many grams of starter are in Fenna's jar now?
w10_T4_003615: Hamid ordered prints of his 121 holiday photos, and he had each photo printed twice. He gave 192 prints to family and friends. He then found 9 extra prints in the envelope, threw away 11 blurry ones, and received 3 prints back from his aunt. He sold every print he had left for 4 cents each at a school fair. He prices things in cents but records the total in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents did Hamid make from the sale?
w10_T4_003617: In the morning, Jia's cash box held 40 dollars from the team's car wash. She divided it equally among 4 envelopes and kept 1 envelope for herself. At lunch she split the money in her envelope equally into 2 parts and gave 1 part to her brother. In the afternoon she divided what she had kept equally among 5 pots and used just 1 pot to start her savings jar, then her grandmother added 44 dollars to the jar. The team plays 12 games this season. In the evening her father doubled the money in the jar. How many dollars are in Jia's savings jar now?
w10_T4_003624: Kenzo keeps 63 beehives, more than the 50 hives his neighbour Lea keeps. Over the winter 12 of his hives are lost. In spring he sells 36 hives to a new beekeeper. Each of his remaining hives produces 9 jars of honey in the season, and he sells every jar for 5 dollars. He spends 100 dollars of the money on new jars and labels. How many dollars does Kenzo have left?
w10_T4_003627: In the morning, a farm shop had 67 boxes of eggs in the storeroom, and a dozen customers were already queuing outside. A delivery of 70 more boxes arrived before lunch. In the afternoon 36 boxes were sent to a restaurant in a van that is 5 metres long. In the evening the shopkeeper counted the eggs: each remaining box holds 4 trays, and each tray holds 6 eggs. How many eggs are in the storeroom?
w10_T4_003628: Lina had 73 cents in her purse, and she checks her purse twice a day. She spent 32 cents on a stamp. She found 37 cents under the sofa and put them in her purse, and her brother paid her 65 cents for a bookmark. She then spent 73 cents on a hair clip. She thinks of her money in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many cents are in Lina's purse now?
w10_T4_003630: Marta earns 30 dollars for each dog she walks, and on Saturday she walks 3 dogs. She also earns 57 dollars for looking after a cat. She spends 58 dollars on groceries and gets a 10 dollar tip from a grateful owner. She then spends 40 dollars on fuel. She keeps her receipts in cents but totals her money in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many dollars does Marta have from the day?
